description: In the OpenCAD system (http://localhost), log in as admin (admin@opencad.local / Admin123!). After logging in you will see the main dashboard with department buttons. Click the DISPATCH button to access the CAD Console. This task requires two actions: (1) NCIC Name Lookup: Scroll down to the 'NCIC Name Lookup' section on the CAD page, enter 'Trevor Philips' in the name field, and click Send to look up this individual. (2) Create Citation: In the left sidebar, expand the 'Citations' menu and click 'Create Citation'. In the citation form, select 'Trevor Philips' from the Civilian Name dropdown, enter 'Reckless Driving' as Citation Name 1, and enter 350 as the fine amount. Click Create to issue the citation. Note: the NCIC lookup and citation creation are separate forms on the CAD page.
